status: Frozen locally after common caches and synthetic tests, before any replication tracker output/evaluation. Not external preregistration. No retuning.

source_terms.dataset: MOT17 train / MOT17-11-DPM and MOT17-13-DPM compressed previews
source_terms.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; original-source conditions may also apply
source_terms.source_column: No additional third-party source link for either selected scene in official table
source_terms.scope: Local non-commercial research only; source media, GT, raw diagnostics not redistributed
source_terms.attribution: MOTChallenge / Milan, Leal-Taixe, Reid, Roth and Schindler; MOT16 benchmark (arXiv:1603.00831)

selection: Different cohort from MOT20-01 and the MOT17-09/10 policy-discovery cohort. Both moving-camera scenes were used in earlier general benchmarks with 8.4.115, but not this control. Fresh shared 8.4.176 caches; not never-seen scenes or held-out evaluation. Entire 900/750 frames, no selection after replication results.

intervention.scope: Only selected second-stage (weak) pairs; confirmed row ID >=0 with predicted age >=2 (at least one fully missed previous frame).
intervention.competition: Another remaining confirmed row with predicted age exactly 1; same weak column similarity >= upstream gate .1 and selected minus competitor similarity <=.05, including negative margins. Alternative may be assigned elsewhere; no proof it owns this detection.
intervention.action: Remove only that selected pair after original assignment. Do not rerun/rematch. Return detection unmatched (ID -1), leave missed state predicted/retained within unchanged buffer. Re-evaluate each next frame; no fixed one-frame promise, lifetime extension or permanent ban.
intervention.unchanged: High stage, births/confirmation, active weak updates, uncontested weak recovery, all original weak input detections, upstream lifecycle/boxes/scores, fixed source-FPS steps, no ReID/GT/CMC/app/worker change.

order: Rotate two arms each repeat; fresh tracker, OpenCV seed 0 and one OpenCV thread. Compare canonical predictions and full trace hashes.

evaluation.official: Clean TrackEval 12c8791b303e0a0b50f753af204249e622d0281a; official MOT17 pedestrian preprocessing, CLEAR IoU .5, Identity, HOTA. Per sequence and combined using official combiners, never average rates.
evaluation.paired_errors: Exact official CLEAR reconciliation; FP at immutable (frame, cache detection), FN/IDSW at (frame, GT). No cross-run native-ID comparison.
evaluation.scenarios: Existing frozen GT-only long-low-visibility and overlap/order-exchange proxies, separate IoU .5 endpoint matching. Report missing endpoints plus paired same-ID gains/losses; not official scenario metrics or physical occlusion proof.
evaluation.screen: Same original research screen applied to EACH sequence and official combined scores; overall passes only when all pass. Do not pool MOT20 results or tune after observing outcomes.
evaluation.timing: No timing or end-to-end throughput claim.
evaluation.added_fn: After exact CLEAR reconciliation, added (frame,GT) misses classified by reference detection: directly deferred now; still emitted; not emitted without current deferral. Report raw IoU .5 support, visibility/overlap/crossing and supporting-deferral-within-1s contexts; correlated observations, not causal ownership.
evaluation.added_idsw: Added (frame,GT) switches use existing gap/raw-support contexts. Record same immutable input detection as reference, reference missing endpoint and nearby geometrically supporting deferrals; native IDs never compared across runs. Added switch timing can shift rather than represent a new physical error episode.

limitations: Scenes are new for this control, but were studied in earlier general benchmarks. Not an untouched test set, blind selection, physical-camera or broad generalisation acceptance.
Moving footage tests unchanged motion-only ByteTrack under camera motion; no CMC/ReID change or causal motion ablation.
Fresh shared 8.4.176 CPU detections use existing runtime overlay, not fresh full Alpha.2 install. Old detector scores are not controls and are not pooled.
Added-error contexts may overlap; support/proximity is not feasible one-to-one matching, correct ownership or causal blame. Preserve raw weak inputs and active continuation.
No Session/worker default, release, RTSP, Windows actual inference/worker, calibrated 3D, endurance or throughput change/acceptance.
public_scope: Reviewed aggregate counts/distributions, configuration/source hashes and attributed numeric plots only. Media, GT, exact event windows, per-frame IDs, raw matrices/diagnostics, notes and local paths stay local.

amendments.change: Import existing frame_matches function in replication runner; first run stopped with NameError during first-scene reporting after six tracker runs. No comparison report completed; no control, parameters, inputs, diagnostic definitions or evaluation algorithm changed. Preserve initial frozen snapshot.
amendments.rerun: Repeat entire two-scene experiment from scratch after this reporting-only repair; verify first-scene prior prediction/trace hashes exactly.
